columns.description: Columns: Cells per row in every inventory. Items that no longer fit move to free cells; an inventory too full for that gets extra rows to hold them.

rows.description: Rows: Rows of cells; the width is the Columns setting.

maxWeight.description: Weight limit: Grams. 0 means no weight limit.

despawnMinutes.description: Disappears after: Items on the ground disappear when nobody touched them for this long.

maxPerPlayer.description: Bags per player: How many bags one character may have on the ground at a time. Dropping next to an own bag adds to it.

rows.description: Rows: Rows of cells; the width is the Columns setting.

noWeaponWheel.description: No GTA weapon wheel: GTA's weapon wheel and switching weapons with the mouse wheel stay off: weapons are taken from the quick slots (1-5).

enabled.description: Weapons wear out: Off: weapons never lose durability, broken ones can be used and the weapon repair kit does nothing.

shots.description: Firearm shots: Shots that take a firearm from 100% to broken when its item sets none (Items > Weapon).

hits.description: Melee hits: Hits that take a melee weapon from 100% to broken when its item sets none (Items > Weapon).

repairPercent.description: Durability after a repair: A repair sets the weapon to this. Weapons at or above it are not listed.

repairTime.description: Repair time: How long the repair's progress bar runs. 0 repairs at once.

maxRepairs.description: Repairs per weapon: How many times one weapon can be repaired. 0 = no limit.
